name: custom-plugins
description: A small, hand-built collection of Claude Code plugins for agentic engineering. Community-grade, MIT-licensed, and easy to install.

plugins.name: architecture-diagrams
plugins.description: Turn a system description into clean diagrams: Mermaid for flows and draw.io for architecture (laid out by draw.io's own engine), with tech-stack icons, aligned labels, and human-sounding copy.

plugins.name: design-authority
plugins.description: Turn a one-line request into a complete Claude Design prompt. Decides the colour system with measured contrast, the type scale, motion, and every component state up front — then refuses to emit the prompt if anything is still vague.
